# Hybrid Dense, Sparse, and Graph Retrieval Fusion — Complete Research Dossier

> Multi-retriever rank fusion combining BM25 keyword matching, dense embedding cosine proximity, and graph topological distance via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

## Concept Metadata
- **Slug**: `hybrid-dense-sparse-and-graph-retrieval-fusion`
- **Parent**: `Retrieval & RAG`
- **Category**: `Context Retrieval`
- **CVS Score**: `4.87`
- **Verification**: Rigorously verified with >= 2 independent unaffiliated quantitative sources.

## Empirical & Theoretical Findings

### Claim: clm:hybrid_rrf_k60_01
**Assertion**: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with smoothing parameter k=60 achieves scale-invariant rank aggregation across unbounded BM25 lexical scores, dense vector cosine similarities, and graph traversal distance metrics without parameter tuning.
- Primary Source: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1571941.1572114
- Corroborating Source(s): https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.11934
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:cormack_sigir_rrf_01, ev:beir_benchmark_fusion_01

### Claim: clm:hybrid_threeway_mrr_02
**Assertion**: Three-way hybrid fusion (sparse lexical BM25 + dense embedding + topological graph PPR) achieves higher Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) and NDCG@10 than any pairwise combination on heterogeneous technical corpora.
- Primary Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.16130
- Corroborating Source(s): https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.07107
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:graphrag_hybrid_eval_01, ev:enterprise_hybrid_benchmark_01

### Claim: clm:hybrid_normalization_robustness_03
**Assertion**: Rank calibration via min-max normalization or z-score standardization before linear combination requires manual tuning per dataset distribution, whereas RRF provides distribution-free robustness across drifting corpus sizes.
- Primary Source: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1571941.1572114
- Corroborating Source(s): https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-45442-5_4
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:cormack_distribution_free_01, ev:springer_multimodal_norm_01
